confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and hostel anchors are steadier than hotel rates (seasonal swing) and drink prices (wide venue spread). Cocktail and wine are set from a draught-beer cross-check (about 3x to 3.3x) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX figure is from search-result text attributed to rba.gov.au and was not re-confirmed (a follow-up search found no 14 October entry); verify on RBA table F11.1 before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: mid-sized Southeast Asian tourist hubs with USD-quoted visitor pricing, such as Luang Prabang and Hoi An, adjusted for July low-season accommodation rates.
